subject.title: feat(channels): add pre-auth access requests and grouped DM allowlists

question: Should OpenClaw core expose blocked DM content through a new pre-auth plugin/internal hook and automatically activate a trusted access-request handler for existing allowlist configurations?
rationale: Tests and proof can establish behavior, but they cannot decide whether raw blocked-sender content, a new public plugin API, and implicit trusted-hook activation are acceptable permanent product and security contracts.

options.title: Narrow And Split
options.body: First land a canonical, explicitly enabled, minimal-payload pre-auth contract, then review grouped allowlists and the access-request workflow as separate changes.

options.title: Accept Full Boundary
options.body: Approve raw pre-auth content exposure, grouped config/API additions, and trusted-hook auto-loading as intentional core contracts after the mechanical blockers are fixed.

options.title: Pause The Direction
options.body: Keep the current admission model unchanged and close or park the PR until a maintainer sponsors a narrower access-request design.

recommendation.title: Narrow And Split
recommendation.body: First land a canonical, explicitly enabled, minimal-payload pre-auth contract, then review grouped allowlists and the access-request workflow as separate changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to the shared channel-ingress, allowlist, command-mutation, and plugin SDK decision surfaces.
